description: Cutover step P2: declare the two fleet classes and create their applications, re-uploading the live PoolWorker code byte for byte. The one step that cannot be undone. The root's row may also plan as an update whose only other difference is its attachment, while the pool Worker updates: one of the Worker's settings waits on a row that runs in the same plan (the pool database command's outcome), so the planner cannot know the attachment until the Worker applies. That is a standing shape on every release that changes what the pool database command is keyed on. It is admitted only when the namespace it resolves to is already recorded, equal on both rows, and the pool Worker still hosts the class; the apply then reads the application and sends nothing.
